summary: All unique quadruplets that sum to target.
mainInsight: Sort, fix the first two numbers with nested loops, and finish with two pointers on the remaining suffix. Skip duplicate values at every level to keep quadruplets unique. This is O(n^3); the same idea generalises to kSum with recursion down to the 2-pointer base case.
canonicalApproach: Sort + two nested loops + two pointers

approaches.summary: Four nested loops over all combinations with a set for uniqueness.

promptVariants: Which technique reduces 4Sum to a simpler problem?
How is the last pair of numbers found efficiently?
options: Sort, fix two numbers, then use two pointers on the rest
Sort, fix one number, then binary search the remaining three
Use a sliding window of size four over the sorted array
Use a max-heap of the four largest sums found so far
cards.answer: Sort, fix two numbers, then use two pointers on the rest
cards.explanation: The sorted order makes the pointer movement direction deterministic.

incorrectOptionExplanations.Sort, fix one number, then binary search: Three unknowns cannot be binary searched directly.
incorrectOptionExplanations.Use a max-heap of the four largest sums: Heaps do not enumerate all unique quadruplets.

promptVariants: How do you avoid duplicate quadruplets?
cards.answer: Skip an element equal to the previous one at the first loop, the second loop (when j > i + 1), and after recording a quadruplet move both pointers past equal neighbours. Because the array is sorted, equal values are adjacent so each distinct combination is considered exactly once.
keyPoints: Skip equal values at every level
Advance both pointers after a match
cards.explanation: Using a set of tuples also works but is slower.
Two nested loops times a linear two-pointer sweep.

promptVariants: Complete the statement: Space complexity (excluding the input): ___
cards.explanation: Only pointers (plus the output and the sort).

promptVariants: What does 4Sum return for [2, 2, 2, 2, 2] with target 8?
options: [[2, 2, 2, 2]]: the duplicates are skipped so it is reported once
[[2, 2, 2, 2]] repeated five times, once per choice of omitted 2
[]: four equal numbers are not allowed
cards.answer: [[2, 2, 2, 2]]: the duplicates are skipped so it is reported once
cards.explanation: Without duplicate skipping you would emit the same quadruplet several times.

incorrectOptionExplanations.[[2, 2, 2, 2, 2]]: all five elements are: A quadruplet has exactly four elements.
